canonical_statement: The review aimed to compare the effectiveness and safety of different SGLT2 inhibitors in patients with heart failure.

canonical_statement: The study was a systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

canonical_statement: The full-text Methods report searches of PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase through 8 April 2024, plus ClinicalTrials.gov and reference-list checking.

canonical_statement: The abstract states that randomized trials were searched through March 2023.

canonical_statement: The search applied no language or publication-period restriction.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: no restriction was made regarding the language or publication period

canonical_statement: Eligible studies were randomized controlled trials comparing an SGLT2 inhibitor with placebo or another SGLT2 inhibitor in patients with heart failure.

canonical_statement: The primary outcomes were all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, myocardial infarction, and hospitalization for heart failure.

canonical_statement: Dichotomous outcomes were synthesized as risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals using frequentist random-effects network meta-analysis in R netmeta/netrank.

canonical_statement: The review categorized I² of 0–25% as low, 25–50% as moderate, and greater than 50% as substantial heterogeneity, with P<0.05 considered significant.
